نبذة

Equinox Beauty & Cosmetic Clinic is a boutique clinic that specialises in both cosmetic and beauty treatments. We pride ourselves as a one-stop shop for all your aesthetic and skin needs. Our treatment ranges from eyebrow shapes to minimally invasive cosmetic treatments. Holistic aesthetic care is our utmost priority. Thus we provide Injectable nutrition to help you glow from the inside out. We pride ourselves on our high standards of quality treatments and clients’ satisfaction. Book now!
